ownership: United States federal government public credit-union Call Report data
source_access: Public anonymous read-only final quarterly bulk ZIP; no CUOnline web-service credential or API access is used.
allowed_use: redistribution with attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing a quarterly branch row as independent confirmation of public access, current hours, membership eligibility, or current service availability
representing NCUA coverage as all credit unions, all financial businesses, or all U.S. businesses
representing foreign branch records as U.S. locations
treating SiteId as globally unique without its credit-union charter scope
merging institutions or locations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: National Credit Union Administration final quarterly Call Report data.
retention: Indefinite for public immutable source and normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Normalized public business records may be redistributed with NCUA attribution, source cycle, archive checksum, provenance, temporal scope, and coverage limitations retained; the retained raw archive is internal source material.
personal_data_handling: The raw FOICU ATTENTION_OF field may contain a public business-contact name. It is retained only inside the internal immutable source archive and is not normalized or published to the registry.
